items.title: Making Something With My Hands
items.note: We did a finger knitting workshop at school — turning a ball of yarn into something wearable using just your hands, no needles needed. I made a scarf.

images.alt: Rithu wearing a pink finger-knitted scarf
Close-up of hands looping pink yarn while finger knitting
Rithu working on a long finger-knitted chain of pink yarn

items.title: Painting a Mandala
items.note: A school craft session spent filling in a big mandala pattern, one colour at a time, until the whole thing came together.

images.alt: Rithu holding a finished, brightly coloured mandala painting on a round canvas

items.title: International Capybara Day
items.note: Students gathered at recess to make capybara keychains — I made one of my own.
